import json,copy
from work import evaluate
with open('requests.json') as f:rqs=json.load(f)
with open('evidence.json') as f:e=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f:p=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f:report=json.load(f)
assert [evaluate(r,e,p) for r in rqs]==report
assert evaluate({'claim':'x','conditions':{}},[],{'required_conditions':['z','a']})=={'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['a','z']}
req={'claim':'c','conditions':{'k':{'b':2,'a':1}}}
ev=[{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':True,'conditions':{'k':{'a':1,'b':2}},'verified':True},{'source':'new','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':{'k':{'b':2,'a':1}},'verified':True,'supersedes':['old']},{'source':'bad','claim':'c','value':9,'conditions':{'k':{'a':1,'b':3}},'verified':True},{'source':'unverified','claim':'c','value':9,'conditions':{'k':{'a':1,'b':2}},'verified':False},{'source':'withdrawn','claim':'c','value':9,'conditions':{'k':{'a':1,'b':2}},'verified':True,'withdrawn':True}]
orig=(copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(ev))
out=evaluate(req,ev,{'required_conditions':['k'],'require_verified':True})
assert out=={'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]}
assert (req,ev)==orig
c=evaluate({'claim':'c','conditions':{}},[{'source':'b','claim':'c','value':1},{'source':'a','claim':'c','value':'1'}],{'required_conditions':[]})
assert c=={'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']}
assert evaluate({'claim':'none','conditions':{}},ev,{'required_conditions':[]})=={'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']}
print('all checks passed')
